corrections.text: The article says 'The Inside Java post credits Angelos Bimpoudis and Gavin Bierman.' The Inside Java page cited as the source shows no byline and no date; those details appear in Inside Java's feed (not cited), and the date is also in the post's URL. The email on the OpenJDK list is sent by Angelos Bimpoudis and signed 'Angelos & Gavin'.

The headline and summary say 'Java language team'. No cited source uses that term: the email's authors write 'we' and describe themselves as 'stewards of the Java language', and Inside Java's About page says its posts do not necessarily represent an 'official view' of the team or of Oracle. The quoted wording of the decision is the email's own.
